library Sampling
{
    //==
    // # Deformation bodies for sampled curves and surfaces
    //
    // The IDeformable2D/IDeformable3D obligations of the discretized parametrics in
    // `sampling.types.plato`. The samples ARE the geometry — between them the
    // types interpolate linearly — so carrying every sample point through the
    // mapping is the discretization of the pointwise deform, and the sample
    // parameters survive unchanged.

    // The IDeformable2D obligation: every sample point carried through the
    // mapping, parameters unchanged.
    Deform(self: SampledCurve2D, mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): SampledCurve2D
        => (self.Parameters, self.Points.Map(mapping));

    // The IDeformable3D obligation: every sample point carried through the
    // mapping, parameters unchanged.
    Deform(self: SampledCurve3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): SampledCurve3D
        => (self.Parameters, self.Points.Map(mapping));

    // The IDeformable3D obligation: every lattice position carried through the
    // mapping, the UV domain unchanged.
    Deform(self: SampledSurfaceGrid, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): SampledSurfaceGrid
        => (self.UvDomain, self.Points.Map(mapping));

    //==
    // # Sampled grid field evaluation
    //
    // The `Eval` bodies for the node-sampled fields of `sampling.types.plato`.
    // Values are stored one per grid NODE, so a grid of n cells along an axis has
    // n + 1 samples on it, read through IIndexable2D's ColumnCount / RowCount. Those
    // bound to a `Row(0).Count` workaround until plato-378 gave Array2D/Array3D an
    // honest layout whose extent FIELDS discharge the obligations.
    //
    // Evaluation is multilinear between the surrounding nodes, and outside the
    // bounds it clamps to the edge — the behaviour the file header states, and the
    // only one that keeps the field total. The clamp happens on the integer node
    // index, not on the position, so a query far outside costs the same as one just
    // outside.
    //
    // The scalar, vector and color families differ only in what is being blended;
    // each type carries its own body because the value type changes, and this
    // vocabulary has no way to write "the multilinear blend of anything
    // IInterpolatable stored in an Array2D".

    //==
    // # Node lookup helpers

    // An index clamped into [0, count - 1]; the edge-clamp of the sampling rule.
    ClampIndex(i: Integer, count: Integer): Integer
        => i.Max(0).Min(count - 1);

    // The fractional node coordinate of a position along one axis: 0 at the
    // grid's minimum, cellCount at its maximum.
    NodeCoordinate(position: Number, min: Number, max: Number, cellCount: Integer): Number
        => max == min ? 0.0 : (position - min) / (max - min) * cellCount.ToNumber;

    //==
    // # SampledScalarGrid2D

    // The number of nodes along X (one more than the cell count).
    NodeColumns(self: SampledScalarGrid2D): Integer
        => self.Values.ColumnCount;

    // The number of nodes along Y.
    NodeRows(self: SampledScalarGrid2D): Integer
        => self.Values.RowCount;

    // The stored value at node (i, j), with both indices edge-clamped.
    NodeValue(self: SampledScalarGrid2D, i: Integer, j: Integer): Number
        => self.Values.Row(ClampIndex(j, self.NodeRows))[ClampIndex(i, self.NodeColumns)];

    // The bilinear blend of the four surrounding node values, clamped at the
    // grid edges.
    Eval(self: SampledScalarGrid2D, p: Point2D): Number {
        var b = self.Grid.Bounds;
        var x = NodeCoordinate(p.X, b.Min.X, b.Max.X, self.Grid.CellCounts.X);
        var y = NodeCoordinate(p.Y, b.Min.Y, b.Max.Y, self.Grid.CellCounts.Y);
        var i = x.Floor.ToInteger;
        var j = y.Floor.ToInteger;
        var u = x - x.Floor;
        var v = y - y.Floor;
        return self.NodeValue(i, j).Lerp(self.NodeValue(i + 1, j), u)
            .Lerp(self.NodeValue(i, j + 1).Lerp(self.NodeValue(i + 1, j + 1), u), v);
    }

    //==
    // # SampledScalarGrid3D
    //
    // Array3D is opaque too, so the layer stride is derived the same way: the
    // linear index of node (i, j, k) is (k * rows + j) * columns + i, the
    // row-major order the type's doc comment fixes.

    // The number of nodes along X.
    NodeColumns(self: SampledScalarGrid3D): Integer
        => self.Grid.CellCounts.X + 1;

    // The number of nodes along Y.
    NodeRows(self: SampledScalarGrid3D): Integer
        => self.Grid.CellCounts.Y + 1;

    // The number of nodes along Z.
    NodeLayers(self: SampledScalarGrid3D): Integer
        => self.Grid.CellCounts.Z + 1;

    // The stored value at node (i, j, k), with every index edge-clamped.
    NodeValue(self: SampledScalarGrid3D, i: Integer, j: Integer, k: Integer): Number {
        var columns = self.NodeColumns;
        var rows = self.NodeRows;
        var ci = ClampIndex(i, columns);
        var cj = ClampIndex(j, rows);
        var ck = ClampIndex(k, self.NodeLayers);
        return self.Values[(ck * rows + cj) * columns + ci];
    }

    // The trilinear blend of the eight surrounding node values.
    Eval(self: SampledScalarGrid3D, p: Point3D): Number {
        var b = self.Grid.Bounds;
        var x = NodeCoordinate(p.X, b.Min.X, b.Max.X, self.Grid.CellCounts.X);
        var y = NodeCoordinate(p.Y, b.Min.Y, b.Max.Y, self.Grid.CellCounts.Y);
        var z = NodeCoordinate(p.Z, b.Min.Z, b.Max.Z, self.Grid.CellCounts.Z);
        var i = x.Floor.ToInteger;
        var j = y.Floor.ToInteger;
        var k = z.Floor.ToInteger;
        var u = x - x.Floor;
        var v = y - y.Floor;
        var w = z - z.Floor;
        var lo = self.NodeValue(i, j, k).Lerp(self.NodeValue(i + 1, j, k), u)
            .Lerp(self.NodeValue(i, j + 1, k).Lerp(self.NodeValue(i + 1, j + 1, k), u), v);
        var hi = self.NodeValue(i, j, k + 1).Lerp(self.NodeValue(i + 1, j, k + 1), u)
            .Lerp(self.NodeValue(i, j + 1, k + 1).Lerp(self.NodeValue(i + 1, j + 1, k + 1), u), v);
        return lo.Lerp(hi, w);
    }

    //==
    // # SampledVectorGrid2D

    // The number of nodes along X.
    NodeColumns(self: SampledVectorGrid2D): Integer
        => self.Values.ColumnCount;
